content: A post-auricular cyst is a condition that can present as an asymptomatic cystic mass located behind the ear. In the case of a healthy 3-year-old boy, an axial CT scan revealed an ovoid cyst situated medial to the concha and slightly protruding into the post-auricular sulcus. The cyst was surgically excised, and the resulting defect was repaired primarily. There were no anatomical connections identified between the cyst and the external auditory canal or the middle ear.
